name: ChatGPT
tagline: The AI assistant that became the default at work
description: OpenAI's AI assistant for text, voice and file analysis, with web search, deep research and thousands of ready-made GPTs for every area.
priceNote: Pricing as of October 2026; plans change — check the official site.
bestFor: Whole teams using AI every day, from drafting to research
pros: The most battle-tested model on the market, with consistent answers across languages
File, spreadsheet, voice, image and deep research features that cover the whole operation
GPTs and apps that connect to Drive, SharePoint and Dropbox, which lifts usage without extra work
Almost zero learning curve: any non-technical person uses it without training
cons: Usage limits at peak times, especially on the Plus plan, break workflows
It is not an automation tool: it depends on copy and paste between systems, with no native ERP integration
The free version is far too limited for professional use and leads people to think it can do the job
Privacy policy and data retention need checking before you upload a client document

features.name: Deep research
features.detail: Multi-step report with sources, useful for benchmarking and market analysis

features.name: File reading
features.detail: Analyzes PDF, spreadsheet, image and text document in a single upload

features.name: Voice and video mode
features.detail: Voice conversation and video analysis inside the app

features.name: GPTs and apps
features.detail: Custom assistants and connectors for Google Drive, Dropbox and SharePoint

features.name: Projects and instructions
features.detail: Dedicated space per project, with history and fixed instructions

useCases: Draft and review sales email replies while keeping the brand tone
Extract the key points from a PDF contract and build an internal legal summary
Turn the monthly performance report into a board-ready presentation
Create canned responses for the most common customer questions, reviewed by the team
bestForWho: Companies that want to give every person an AI assistant, from sales to admin, without building a system.
verdict: ChatGPT is the safest choice for scaled adoption, because almost everyone already knows how to use it and the use cases show up on their own in daily work. The blind spot is integration: it answers very well, but it does not connect natively to your ERP, and the copy and paste comes back every hour. For processes that depend on system data, automation does the heavy lifting, not the chat. For a small company, the Plus plan for the sales and admin team is the best value for money. For a larger company, evaluate the Business plan for its workspace controls and the guarantee that company data is not used for training, and confirm the plan limits before you put a critical commercial process on top, because that changes as traffic grows.
